title: AI Product Developer Intern
description: AI Developer Intern role. Work with LLMs, Generative AI APIs, prompt engineering, AI agents, automation workflows. Must have: basic Python/JS, understanding of APIs/JSON, interest in Generative AI and LLMs, prompt engineering concepts. Good to have: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, vector databases, RAG, embeddings, previous AI/ML projects.

title: ML Engineer
description: ML Engineer (Fresher) to support development, training, and evaluation of ML models. Strong foundation in Python, core ML concepts (supervised/unsupervised, regression, classification). Basic knowledge of NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn. Preferred: personal/academic ML projects, TensorFlow/PyTorch, SQL, Git.

title: AI Developer (Junior)
description: Junior AI Developer, 0-3 years. Work on Computer Vision applications, NLP and LLM-powered systems, RAG based solutions, AI integrations. Required: Python, basic ML/DL, familiarity with Computer Vision or NLP/LLMs or RAG pipelines/Vector Databases. Good to have: PyTorch/TensorFlow, LangChain/LlamaIndex, APIs.

title: AI Engineer - Fresher
description: AI Engineer Fresher role. Develop and implement AI/ML models, work with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face. Explore Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, computer vision. Prepare/clean datasets, model training/evaluation/deployment. Required: Python, basic ML/DL, algorithms, SQL/Git/REST APIs preferred.
